summary: Verified KYC Admin Reupload Feature - All features working correctly. Backend accepts decision=reupload, sets reupload_requested and admin_note. Customer sees admin hints in KYC status and VerificationPage. Admin KYC panel shows note field and Nachupload button. Live image warnings integrated in KYCFlow.
seed_data_creation: Used existing rejected KYC test user, set reupload_requested=true via admin endpoint
context_for_next_testing_agent: KYC Admin Reupload feature fully verified. Key data-testids: admin-kyc-note-*, admin-kyc-reupload-*, kyc-admin-reupload-card, verification-admin-reupload-card, kyc-live-warning-front/back/selfie. Backend endpoint /api/admin/customers/{user_id}/kyc accepts decision=reupload and sets reupload_requested=true, admin_note, and user_feedback correctly.

admin_kyc_note_field.details: Admin KYC panel shows 'Admin-Notiz für Kunde / Nachupload' textarea for each KYC request with data-testid='admin-kyc-note-{user_id}'

admin_kyc_reupload_button.details: Admin KYC panel shows 'Nachupload' button (amber) with data-testid='admin-kyc-reupload-{user_id}'

backend_reupload_decision.details: POST /api/admin/customers/{user_id}/kyc with decision=reupload sets reupload_requested=true, admin_note, user_feedback, and resets failed_attempts to 0

customer_sees_admin_note.details: GET /api/kyc/status returns admin_note and reupload_requested=true. Customer sees 'ADMIN-NACHUPLOAD ANGEFORDERT' card on KYCFlow status page

verification_page_admin_reupload_card.details: VerificationPage shows 'Admin hat einen Nachupload angefordert' card with data-testid='verification-admin-reupload-card'

kyc_flow_admin_reupload_card.details: KYCFlow status page shows 'ADMIN-NACHUPLOAD ANGEFORDERT' card with data-testid='kyc-admin-reupload-card'

live_image_warnings.details: kycImageInspector.js integrated in KYCFlow.jsx. Live warnings appear with data-testid='kyc-live-warning-{slot}' after file upload if image has low resolution or is too dark

kyc_image_issue_grid.details: KYCImageIssueGrid component shows Vorderseite, Rückseite, Selfie status with color coding on both VerificationPage and KYCFlow

playwright_tests.test: KYCFlow Status Page Admin Reupload Card

notes: All requested features are working correctly. The admin can write notes and request reupload via the KYC panel. Customers see the admin hints on both VerificationPage and KYCFlow. Live image quality warnings are integrated and appear after file upload if issues are detected.
